chunk_map.heading: Criteria keep a floor and can raise a ceiling

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: a projected slide with a pronoun nobody can resolve. Closest: L7 'That difference lives in someone's head' and 'Write it down, and it becomes criteria' resolve to the forgettable-vs-worth-reading difference set up in L5-6, same chunk; 'The floor'/'The ceiling' (L9) are named in the header.

rules_evaluated.na_reason: no pointer to another file or deck position

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw' reference to a beat

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: a slide that says nothing standalone. Chunk carries the full floor/ceiling claim with a contrast pair (L3-L9); closest to thin is the 2-sentence L9, which still lands the point.
Harm: header contradicted by content. L1 'Criteria keep a floor and can raise a ceiling' vs L3 floor paragraph, L5-6 grounded-but-forgettable contrast, L9 ceiling; header is a true summary.

Harm: a tic that reads as machine cadence on a wall. Closest: L3 'Every customer quote traces to an interview. Every number traces to its report. Every claim points to evidence or says what is missing.' - anaphora triple, but the third leg adds new content (claims, and the gap-admission clause) rather than echoing; no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.', no superlative, no number+retraction, no empty verb triplet (L5 'names the tradeoff, keeps the customer's own words and makes the next decision obvious' are three concrete moves).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: repo vocabulary on a wall. grep body for compendium/forcing function/beat/mood/surface/firing -> 0 hits in body L1-L9; 'criteria', 'floor', 'ceiling', 'grounded' are ordinary product-team words; maintainer block notes 'eval' vocabulary was deliberately avoided.
